# So: find minimal ph,pv and tiles consistent; fill 8s. For test: compute ph by matching masked rows against unmasked rows? General: for each masked row, its tile must agree on known cells with some tile candidate from unmasked rows. Ambiguity remains when few anchors.
# Alternative approach for general: search all pairs (ph,pv) globally, consistency across whole grid. Grid fully periodic => do[r][c] == T[r%ph][c%pv]. Solve: for each candidate tile assignment per cell (r%ph,c%pv), value = majority/consistent non-8. Then fill. That works if (ph,pv) is known... we don't know it. But maybe choose minimal ph * pv over 1..H,1..W. Demo: try!
import itertools
def f2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for ph in range(1,H+1):
        for pv in range(1,W+1):
            # build tile table with conflicts flagged
            t=[[None]*pv for _ in range(ph)]
            conflict=False
            for r in range(H):
                for c in range(W):
                    v=g[r][c]
                    if v!=8:
                        jt=(r%ph,c%pv)
                        if t[jt] is not None and t[jt]!=v: conflict=True;break
                        t[jt]=v
                if conflict: break
            if conflict: continue
            # fill
            out=[[t[r%ph][c%pv] if t[r%ph][c%pv] is not None else g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
            if best is None or ph*pv < best[0]*best[1]: best=(out,ph,pv)
    return best[0],best[1],best[2]
